model_extension.form: multiply positive-ion lower-wall flux by 1 + amplitude * sigmoid((radius - onset_radius) / width), then normalize by its continuous wafer-area mean
model_extension.physical_interpretation: curved wafer-edge/focus-ring sheath redistributes directional ion current within a narrow edge boundary layer while conserving total wafer ion current

require leave-one-lot-out calibration and grid-refinement margins

v3_calibration_failure_evidence.interpretation: smooth volume-production moments are exhausted; the remaining edge-localized signature motivates an ion sheath/focus-ring boundary closure
